indicators.context: Strix telemetry, on by default (STRIX_TELEMETRY): POST /scan_started/<version>, /finding_reported/<version>?severity=... and /scan_ended/<version> on every scan (strix/telemetry/scarf.py:29). Seen from your network, Strix ran from your network

indicators.context: Strix's PostHog project key, sent in every telemetry POST to us.i.posthog.com/capture/ (strix/telemetry/posthog.py:25). Visible only with TLS inspection
